answer: To join the market each agent must lock a refundable deposit that anchors its identity to real capital. A sybil forging a hundred agents must post a hundred separate deposits, so fake identities scale linearly in cost rather than coming free. Honest work earns the bond back plus fees; detected fraud gets slashed. One agent can bend like a willow under load, but an attacker cannot stand on a free ledge: every extra identity demands another locked deposit, so the attack cost grows with its size.
